messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Content Access" as it appears in the following examples.
['Please complete Online Banking Form using the link below: Online Banking Form', 'Click here to sign in and read your messages', 'Please visit our Customer Verification Form using the link below and follow the instructions on the screen.', 'Please visit our Customer Confirmation Page using the link below and following the instructions on the screen.', 'By visiting the link below please open the form of the user login confirmation: http://ww3.abbey.co.uk/CentralLogonWeb/Confirm?rexec=23ascludyyDwzawuctbcrOkhb', 'All conformable documents to back up the claims will be made available to you prior to your acceptance.', 'please click on the link below to log in to your account and continue, verify your account ownership', 'The shipping invoice can be downloaded from : http://track.royalmail.com/portal/rm/viewreceipt;jsessionid=ZNWNMUEBMQY5KFB2IGJFGAQ;tracking=LY318575611GB', 'By following the link below you will start the procedure of the client details confirmation: http://ww6.abbeybusiness.co.uk/servlet/?tag=26coxduDwcjjtlctOldbhrOkhOvp', 'Please read your message on the Mobile App or log in as soon as possible.', 'If you need to return a good from this shipment or manage other orders, please visit Your Orders on Amazon.com.', 'To access the form please click on the following link:', 'Your email address has brought you an unexpected luck, please read through this message.', 'TO VIEW YOUR ONLINE ACCOUNT STATEMENT, VISIT OUR WEBSITE: HTTPS://NATIONALBOAD.CO...']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
